sections.title: Overview
sections.html_content: Send hassle-free push notifications—no mailing lists or phone numbers required.

sections.title: Initial Objectives
sections.html_content: Email inboxes are overwhelmed, and managing text message threads can be a nightmare—what if there were an easier way to keep everyone up-to-date and not miss important updates?

sections.title: Solution
sections.html_content:
Musubi is a dedicated push notifications app that gives you back control of what, when, and how you receive notifications, while making sending a notification as easy as hitting "send."

Scan a QR code or tap a link to subscribe and self-manage your subscriptions.
